item.title: Kyverno threat model: the defaults that make enforcement optional
item.description: Fail open, by default Audit mode is not enforcement PolicyException: the quiet bypass Kyverno doesn’t watch its own namespace What Kyverno can never protect Sign and verify, not either Turning the admission controller into an SSRF probe Summary ControlPlane published a threat model and hardening guide for Kyverno in April 2026, done with the CNCF and reviewed by Kyverno’s own maintainers (Jim Bugwadia and Shuting Zhao among them).
